title: KATSEYE & Kuromi Are Bringing Their ‘WILD’ Energy to Target With a New Collection
summary: The K-pop act marks its latest EP release with a Kuromi collection featuring apparel, collectibles, drinkware and more.
contentText:
All products and services featured are independently chosen by editors. However, Billboard may receive a commission on orders placed through its retail links, and the retailer may receive certain auditable data for accounting purposes.

KATSEYE’s latest era has arrived with a little help from Kuromi. The global girl group released its third EP, WILD , on Friday (Aug. 14), and is celebrating with a new Sanrio collaboration launching exclusively at Target. The KATSEYE x Kuromi collection brings the pop group and Sanrio character together across apparel, collectibles, drinkware, snacks and more.

The fashion assortment includes graphic tees featuring KATSEYE and Kuromi, a matching gray crewneck sweatsuit, a Kuromi ears beanie and a purple clear stadium bag that’s ideal for music festivals and concerts. Prices range from $10 to $30.

For collectors, the assortment includes Kuromi plush charms, keychains and collectible figurines, with prices starting at $6.99. EYEKONS can also find KATSEYE x Kuromi designs across drinkware, snacks and other items in the collection.

Best ‘WILD’ Accessories & Merch From Target

PINKY UP

Zak Designs Kuromi x KATSEYE 30oz Straw Tumbler in Black

$22.99

Buy Now AT target

This drinkware features vacuum insulation to keep beverages cold.

EYEKONS, you might want to make room in the cup holder. This 30-ounce black tumbler brings KATSEYE and Kuromi together in one fun design, and includes a straw for sipping your favorite drinks on the go.

CUTE & COLLECTIBLE

YuMe Kuromi x KATSEYE Plush Bag Charm With Lanyard

$12.99

More than 200-plus shoppers have already purchased this plush collectible.

Bag charms have become one of the easiest ways to personalize your everyday accessory, and this plush Kuromi charm is a cute way to get in on the trend. It comes with a lanyard for easy attachment to your favorite tote, purse or backpack, while giving EYEKONS a fun way to rep the group.

CONCERT-APPROVED

Kuromi x Katseye Graphic Crossbody Bag

$20

This lightweight clear bag measures 6 inches by 5 inches by 9 inches.

A good concert bag needs to hold the essentials without getting in the way, and this crossbody fits the bill. The compact design features a KATSEYE x Kuromi graphic and leaves your hands free for dancing, photos and, of course, holding up your phone during the encore.

MINI SURPRISE

YuMe Kuromi x KATSEYE Figurine – Blind Box

$6.99

More than 1,000 shoppers have already added this collectible to their cart.

You won’t know which one you’re getting until you open it. This blind box includes one of three 2-inch Kuromi figures inspired by KATSEYE, making it a fun little collectible for fans.

COLD-WEATHER PICK

Kuromi x KATSEYE Graphic Beanie Hat in Black

$15

The beanie features an embroidered Kuromi motif on the front.

Top off your concert look with this Kuromi beanie, made from cozy 100% acrylic knit fabric. The rolled cuff features an embroidered motif, while the ear accents give the winter accessory a little more personality.

MATCHING SET

Kuromi x KATSEYE Fleece Graphic Crew Sweatshirt

$30

This garment is available in sizes ranging from XXS to 3X.

This sweatshirt gives the classic crewneck a KATSEYE and Kuromi update. Made from a cotton-polyester fleece blend, it has a washed finish, “Kuromi x KATSEYE” text and a poster-style graphic on the front, plus rhinestone detailing for a little extra shine.

COORDINATED LOOK

Kuromi x KATSEYE Graphic Pull-On Pants

Choose from sizes XXS to 3X.

These pull-on pants are part of a matching set with the coordinating Kuromi x KATSEYE sweatshirt, so you can wear them together or mix them into your existing wardrobe. They’re made from a cotton-polyester fleece blend and feature a drawstring waist, flared legs and two side pockets.

UNDER $20 TEE

Kuromi x KATSEYE Oversized Short Sleeve Graphic T-Shirt

$18

This graphic tee has an oversized fit.

The oversized fit makes this graphic tee easy to style with jeans, sweats or shorts. Made from a cotton-polyester jersey blend, it features “Kuromi x KATSEYE” text and the group on the front, with member names on the back.

TARGET EXCLUSIVE

KATSEYE Hoodie

$50

This black hoodie puts the group’s latest era front and center.

The fleece pullover is made from an 80% cotton and 20% polyester blend, with a mint “WILD” graphic on the front and a member photo print and EP3 setlist design on the back.

TOUR READY

KATSEYE T-Shirt (Target Exclusive)

This is a lightweight graphic tee made from 100% cotton.

This is the kind of graphic tee you can wear to a concert and keep in your regular rotation. The 100% cotton design features pink member prints on the front and a bold “WILD” graphic on the back, with a casual fit that’s easy to style.

The collaboration arrives during a busy stretch for KATSEYE. The group was named TikTok’s 2025 global artist of the year earned two 2026 Grammy nominations. KATSEYE has also made a strong showing on the Billboard Hot 100 , with “Animal” debuting at No. 24 on the Aug. 8-dated chart, surpassing “PINKY UP,” which arrived at No. 28 in April. Both songs appear on the new EP.

KATSEYE will bring the new era to the stage with THE WILDWORLD TOUR , which begins in the U.K. Sept. 1 in Dublin before heading through North America beginning in October.

The KATSEYE x Kuromi collection is available exclusively at Target stores and online while supplies last.
